title: Isandro and the Protocol
author: Orsen Whitlock
blurb: Jude Vasquez, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
